subject: Re: Meta-reg kickoff — status + the beta-tuning wrinkle
body:
Status:

- Reproduction landed 02-25, two days early. On the non-mutually-exclusive few-shot setup, the unregularized meta-learner does exactly what the paper warns: it collapses to a zero-shot solution that ignores task training data. With the meta-regularization objective on, adaptation is restored and we match the published accuracy within 0.7%.
- Amara's drop-in packaging is in review; API is one extra loss term plus a strength coefficient.

Wrinkle for the A/B: the regularization strength matters more than we'd like. Too low and memorization creeps back on the vision team's task distribution; too high and we underfit the amortized component. We're shipping a default tuned on their held-out task split, but the honest position is teams with very different task structure will need a short sweep — Wanjiru is adding a 3-point auto-sweep option (~2x meta-training cost when enabled) to the harness.

Still on track for the 04-13 A/B.

Freya
